sources.title: Chongqing Yangtze River Cableway, Changjiang Ropeway
sources.content:
The Yangtze River Cableway, also called Changjiang Ropeway, is the first air corridor on the Yangtze River. This 1,166-meter cable system has been operating safely over 30 years and takes approximately five minutes for a one-way journey.

The North Station sits at 151 of Xinhua Road, Yuzhong District near Jiefangbei Square, accessible via CRT subway Lines 1 or 6 at Xiaoshizi Station (Exit 5B). The South Station is in Nan'an District, reachable by Line 6 at Shangxin Street Station.

Operating Hours: April-October: 8:00-22:00. November-March: 8:00-21:00. Public holidays: 7:30-22:30.

Experience: Visitors enjoy a panoramic view of buildings, river and mountains of Chongqing during daytime. Evening rides showcase Chongqing's illuminated cityscape reflected on the river.

Safety Guidelines: Prohibits passengers with heart disease, hypertension, or acrophobia. Drunken individuals cannot board. Articles exceeding 1.8 meters in length and prohibited items restricted.

sources.title: Chongqing Cableway: Ultimate Guide to the Yangtze River Crossing
sources.content:
The Yangtze River Cableway serves as the world's only cross-river passenger cableway, operating since 1987. It's described as an "air bus" that has become iconic to the city's transportation identity.

Address: No. 4 Xinhua Road, Yuzhong District
Operating Hours: Daily, 6:30 AM - 10:00 PM
Cost: 5 RMB one-way
Duration: Approximately 4 minutes

Recommended visiting time: during sunset to enjoy the cityscape and night views, optimal timing 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM.

Built in 1987, the cableway has witnessed Chongqing's tremendous transformation over time and represents the city's innovative three-dimensional transportation network.

Practical Tips: Check weather beforehand; rainy or foggy conditions may cause temporary suspensions. Respect local commuters by maintaining silence. A 24-hour English service hotline is available: 023-63111111. International travelers can use Alipay or WeChat Pay.

sources.title: The Yangtze River Cableway, A Signature Transportation and Scenic Marvel
sources.content:
The Yangtze River Cableway is an iconic transportation system in Chongqing, known as the first aerial corridor across the Yangtze River. Inaugurated on October 24, 1987, the cableway spans 1,166 meters across the Yangtze River, connecting New Huaroad (Chang'an Temple) in Yuzhong District to Shangxin Street (Longmenhao) in Nan'an District.

The speed of the cableway is 6 meters per second, and the whole tour takes 4 minutes. The cable car features orange-colored cabins with panoramic windows, accommodating approximately 50 passengers per trip.

The ideal time for a scenic ride is during the evening. It is recommended to come during non-popular times on weekdays to reduce waiting time. From the Liberation Monument, it's a 10 minute walk.

sources.title: Crossing the Yangtze River on the Chongqing Cable Car
sources.content: A firsthand account of crossing the Yangtze River on the Chongqing Cable Car. The experience offers stunning views of the Yangtze River and the Chongqing skyline. The cable car is a unique transportation experience that doubles as a tourist attraction. The ride is short but memorable, especially during sunset hours.

sources.title: Yangtze River Cableway (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Yangtze River Cableway visitor reviews. A must-do experience in Chongqing. Short ride but great views. Can get very crowded so go early or on weekdays. Evening rides offer the best views with city lights. Easily accessible from Xiaoshizi metro station. Worth the wait.

sources.title: 长江索道_百度百科
sources.content:
长江索道位于中国重庆市，往返于渝中区的新华路和南岸区的上新街，于1986年3月20日动工兴建，1987年10月24日竣工开通运营。是中国自行设计制造的第一条大型跨越长江的客运索道。

全长1166米，运行速度每秒6米，单程耗时4分30秒。景区由渝中城史文化区、长江空中观光区、南岸影视文化区三部分组成，面积9.8平方千米。

索道采用双承载、双牵引的往复式设计。设计师石奉强创新开发了简易轻便的双牵引支索器和防摆装置等设备。2014年起完成旅游业转型，成为全国唯一的都市观光索道。

开放时间：旺季（3月-10月）7:30-22:30；淡季（11月-2月）7:30-21:30
门票价格（2025年3月31日起）：单程30元，往返50元，单程含耳机40元
交通方式：轨道交通1号线、6号线小什字站；公交T002、T480、881、0491路

荣誉：2009年被列为市文物保护单位，2018年获评AAAA级景区，2019年入选智慧旅游示范景区，2020年当选成渝潮流新地标。

sources.title: Yangtze River Cableway | ichongqing
sources.content: The Yangtze River Cableway is a unique transportation experience in Chongqing, operating since 1987. It crosses the Yangtze River between Yuzhong and Nan'an districts, offering panoramic views of the city skyline. The ride takes approximately 4 minutes. Best experienced during sunset or evening hours for stunning night views of the city.
